reason: Make suite-selection chronology and finite-sample uncertainty explicit after reviewer feedback.

suite_selection.rule: Choose banking because the model-free trusted-turn re-derivability audit found the highest suite-level coverage (6/8, 75%).
suite_selection.chronology: The audit and banking choice preceded inspection of either GPT-5.4-nano arm's outcomes.
suite_selection.prior_information: AgentDojo outcomes from an earlier model family already existed; this study is therefore described as a frozen current-model replication and narrow applicability test, not an outcome-blind comparison across suites.

analysis_change: Add two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for marginal attack-success and utility rates; retain the paired McNemar test and two-way cluster bootstrap as the primary comparison.
